name: Maeda Kiyoto
source:
One of Sayaka's students.

He is an academically gifted, cheerful, and serious young man, the typical model student.

As president of the drama club, he is also very dedicated to its activities, and dreams of someday establishing his own theater troupe.

He is a handsome young man with a cute appearance, somewhat reminiscent of a small animal. He even has a secret fan club among the students.

However, he himself has been secretly in love with Sayaka, his drama club advisor, ever since he first enrolled at the academy. He has never had a romantic relationship with another woman.

He is rather self-conscious about his height. He has set himself the goal of growing beyond 170 centimeters before graduation, telling himself:

"If I'm going to be a man, I want to be at least 170 centimeters tall. I'll grow past 170 before graduation and confess my feelings to Sensei."

However, upon learning that Sayaka is engaged, he finds that he can no longer keep his feelings under control...

[Translated from [url=https://www.lune-soft.jp/game/11291]the official site[/url]]
